findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a pull request changes a board script or stylesheet.
The board-specific test still uses `--collect-only` and invokes `forge test --pytest`, then checks printed file names. The new `forge test --change` test runs a synthetic client folder reader, not Forge’s board tests. Forge’s actual pull-request workflow runs `forge test --change` at `.github/workflows/forge.yml:88`. For example, a platform-test filter in Forge’s `forge.toml` could skip `tests/test_board_item_tab_in_address.py` in that check while both new tests still pass. The requested proof of browser-test execution remains missing.
findings.title: Gate: prove the pull request check runs the board browser tests

stop.reason: The owner accepts the proof note: the coordinator reads this pull request's own check log and merges only if it shows that the board's browser tests ran

why: The pull-request check picks tests by the Python files that changed, so a change to the board's script or style files (src/forge/board_app) merges with the board's browser tests not run; the tab-in-address fix made the default branch red this way
